afternoon_audit.rule_under_test: M15 DMI/MACD reversal and >1.55 ATR EMA20 extension
afternoon_audit.sample_warning: Directional movements are NOT filled trades, realised losses, success probabilities or evidence sufficient to change champion parameters.

data_policy: Research-only, no orders. Hourly OANDA quote not Pepperstone executable quote.

early_entry_study.policy: Compare a completed M5 alternative against the original M15 route prospectively. Count losses, no-fills and costs. Broker screenshots never auto-approve entries.

execution_lessons.action: Treat watch-only candidates as NOT APPROVED; require a fresh independently confirmed entry.

broker.policy: No broker screenshots train strategy weights until independently linked to original immutable signal, trigger, fill and exit.

positive_review_queue.next_step: Compare frozen prospective route against losses, costs, missed entries and no-fills.
